name: – After § 20 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text: 20a. Regrets the absence of a sufficiently empowered EU peace envoy for Ukraine; calls on the Council and the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy to appoint one without delay, with a mandate to coordinate EU diplomatic efforts and ensure that an immediate ceasefire, civilian protection and the safe return of all deported and forcibly transferred Ukrainian children remain central priorities in all negotiations; stresses that the effective protection of Ukrainian children ultimately depends on a just and lasting peace;
